title: Chapter 115 This Is My Wife
content:
Chapter 115 This Is My Wife

Seeing Huang Shou like this, Lu Daosheng saw at a glance what Huang Shou was thinking.

"Well, Huang Shou, this is my wife, Xiaoxue's biological mother."

At this time, Lu Daosheng said lightly.

Hearing this, Huang Shou smiled and said, "It turns out it's your wife,"

"Ah? What?"

Xiaoxue’s biological mother? !

Hiss ~

Suddenly, Huang Shou looked at Yan Lingyun with a shocked look.

They were all unfamiliar with Lu Xue's biological mother, and they didn't even know anything about it.

They even thought that Lu Xue's biological mother had long been gone.

However, neither the city lord nor Miss Lu Xue said, so they had never asked.

And now, Lu Xue’s mother is actually back.

At this time, Lu Daosheng had already pulled Yan Lingyun into the city, leaving only Huang Shou who was still in the same place with a shocked look on his face.

On the streets in the city, there are pedestrians, extremely prosperous.

Lu Daosheng pulled Yan Lingyun and walked silently inside.

In order to avoid causing restlessness in the city, Lu Daosheng deliberately changed his appearance, but even so, it still attracted the attention of many people.

There is no way, the appearance can be changed, but the temperament cannot be changed.

Yan Lingyun is even more unspeakable. She looks beautiful and beautiful, and her almost innate sense of oppression makes it difficult not to attract attention.

"Lingyun, this is the city I built. What do you think?"

As he walked, Lu Daosheng said slowly.

At this time, Yan Lingyun was still looking at the city. When Yan Lingyun heard Lu Daosheng's words, he nodded.

"It's very good, where do you get so many,"

Just as he was about to ask Lu Daosheng where he got so many resources, he thought of Lu Daosheng's unpredictable strength, Yan Lingyun suddenly came to an abrupt end.

After a moment of silence, Yan Lingyun whispered, "Daosheng, I left without saying goodbye back then. Do you hate me very much?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned.

If you don’t hate at all, it must be fake. After all, it’s really irresponsible to leave the father and daughter behind without even saying hello.

After pondering for a moment, Lu Daosheng shook his head and said, "It's all over. Now, nothing can separate us from us."

When Lu Daosheng learned that Yan Lingyun had to leave because he did not implicate them, he only had a deep love for Yan Lingyun.

He knew that Yan Lingyun was a very strong person. He had no ability at the beginning and could not do anything.

But now, he can say responsibly that he can protect the mother and the two for the rest of their lives.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun's nose suddenly felt sore.

In fact, she has long regretted it after so many years.

I was still a little impulsive at that time.

But there was no way. The situation was urgent at the time. If it was noticed, then I might be fine. Lu Daosheng and Lu Xue would definitely not be so lucky.

That's why she had no choice but to leave quickly.

Now I think about it, what if Lu Daosheng and the others had an accident after they left.

Then even if you solve everything yourself, what's the point?

Fortunately, everything was safe, even far beyond her imagination.

The person I have always wanted to protect suddenly became invincible.

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly stopped.

"Daosheng?"

Yan Lingyun was a little confused and turned her head to look at Lu Daosheng, and saw Lu Daosheng looking into the distance as if he was smiling.

Following Lu Daosheng's gaze, he immediately saw three people sitting around the tavern drinking.

"Haha, Viagra, you won't be able to do it."

An Xing raised his wine glass, looked at Awei, whose face was slightly red due to drinking, and said provocatively.

The wines in this deserted city are all specially brewed, but no matter what level you are at, you will get drunk after drinking. Of course, unless you use the power in your body to relieve the wine.

But those who come to drink will naturally not do this.

At this time, Awei was obviously a little bit over the top.

"Who, who can't do it anymore, continue."

Then Awei poured himself a full cup.

On the side, Gu Chen refused to admit defeat, raised his glass and touched the three of them, and then drank it all in one go.

At this time, An Xing glanced inadvertently in the direction behind Awei.

"Puff~"

Suddenly, An Xing directly squirted Awei's face with wine.

Then he stood up with a loud voice.

"An Xing! What's wrong with you?!"

Awei touched his face and stared at An Xing with some anger, but then Awei was slightly stunned and saw that An Xing's eyes were complicated at this moment.

There was a hint of panic in shock, and a hint of embarrassment in doubt.

Immediately, Awei and Gu Chen turned around and looked at each other, and immediately found Lu Daosheng staring at the three of them and laughing.

"You three are drinking very well."

Lu Daosheng sneered.

I'll catch it.

thump!

The three of them immediately knelt down to Lu Daosheng.

"I have met the city lord."

At this time, Lu Daosheng had set up a barrier here, and passers-by outside could not see the scene here.

And An Xing and the other two also woke up in an instant, without any intention of drinking.

Awei even scolded An Xing in his heart.

Damn, I have to drink, I have to drink, now it's OK.

I actually met the city lord.

Awei knew Lu Daosheng very well. What Lu Daosheng hated the most was that someone was drinking on his back.

Of course, that was the past.

At that time, the deserted city was still very poor, so naturally I cherished the wine.

I saw Lu Daosheng wave his hand and said casually: "Get up."

"Thank you, Lord!"

The three of them quickly got up.

The city lord didn't say anything?

Awei was confused, and at this time, he suddenly noticed Yan Lingyun beside Lu Daosheng.

I saw that the two of them were holding hands!

An Xing and Gu Chen on the side obviously noticed this and were shocked.

Is there a woman around the city lord? !

"Sir, who is this?"

At this time, Gu Chen boldly stepped forward and asked.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng said indifferently: "This is my wife, Yan Lingyun, and Xiaoxue's biological mother."

boom!

As soon as these words came out, the three of them were stunned as if they were thundering.

After a long time, the three of them could barely react and then said respectfully to Yan Lingyun: "I have met Mrs.!"

Yan Lingyun was also a little stunned. She was obviously not used to this title, but she still nodded and signaled.

"Okay, it's nothing to drink some wine. Remember not to drink too much."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand, then pulled Yan Lingyun straight to the city lord's mansion.

In place, the three of them looked at the backs of Lu Daosheng and his two people, and their thoughts were full of thoughts.

It’s different if you have a wife.

Obviously, because Lu Daosheng was in a good mood, he did not pursue the three of them, but instead reminded them not to drink too much.

At this time, Awei coughed lightly and said, "Two, let's say goodbye first, I'll go home to find my wife."

Then Awei left directly.

An Xing and Gu Chen were left behind to stand in the wind and be in a mess.

"Hmph, woman, it will only affect my speed of attack."

An Xing snorted.

On the side, Gu Chen nodded in agreement.

"This statement makes sense."

The last stubbornness from a single dog.

Unfortunately, Gu Chen would never have thought that An Xing, who was jointly maintaining the dignity of a single dog, would be suddenly stabbed to him one day in the future.

......

In the city lord's mansion.

"Woooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo

Lu Xue kept crying, obviously unable to accept the fact that her mother suddenly came back and left immediately.

"My little master, stop crying, I can't even sleep."

At this time, Ao Qing couldn't help but speak.

Hearing Ao Qing's words, Lu Xue pulled Ao Qing out of her sleeve and threw it out.

"Get out!"

Bang!

Ao Qing was thrown out of the room by Lu Xue.

Stabilizing his body, Ao Qing's head was buzzing. As soon as he realized, he felt the breath behind him.

"Um?"

"Master! You're back!"

When Ao Qing saw Lu Daosheng, he immediately said excitedly.

Lu Daosheng raised a finger to his mouth, "Shh."

Seeing this, Ao Qing quickly shut up.

Lu Daosheng turned his head and looked at Yan Lingyun and nodded.

Yan Lingyun looked at the room and listened to Lu Xue's crying in the room, and a strong sense of self-blame suddenly surged in her heart.

Then, Yan Lingyun took a deep breath and slowly walked into the room with a nervous mood.
